rubric_items.reason: All 15 acceptance criteria (S-1 AC1-AC5, S-2 AC1-AC3, S-3 AC1, S-4 AC1-AC3, S-5 AC1-AC3) have at least one test, and no test claims a criterion that does not exist. TP-19 is mapped loosely.

The API rule and the fields are tested at Supertest integration level, which is needed for the clock, zone and DB. Rendering is tested at Testing Library unit level. The existing DOC-7 lib and doctor tests are reused, not duplicated. Nothing is e2e or manual.

Good boundaries: the exact start instant (TP-5), UTC midnight in Asia/Kolkata (TP-7) and the 51st appointment (TP-6). Negatives: 404 (TP-19) and no leak into summaries (TP-20). But the new fields on the changed POST endpoints EP-2 to EP-6 are not checked.

Tools match the strategy (Vitest, Supertest, fixed clock, jsdom, Testing Library), and the PG skip and the no-browser gap are noted. But the plan names no target test files, the API folder is never named, and AppointmentDetailPage has no existing web test to sit beside.
Titles are concrete and runnable. TP-15 leaves out the Inactive-doctor setup the S-4 ACs require. Tests list story ACs but not the REQ-n prefix their names must start with.
